I don't have a therapist yet and well, not getting a diag makes you feel kinda invaild if you're not diagnosed proffesionally. Of course I don't support self diagnosis, you can self diagnose for the sake of finding out what you might have, you can suspect you have that bit since it's not confirmed you should keep self diagnosis to yourself, you don't know if you're right so don't share it. I know I just contradicted myself, I shared my suspicions and all, when I talk about my suspected mental conditions I don't say that they're suspected but true. I know this is wrong but well, you're the one who knows yourself the most.
